prompt_inputs.goal: Marathon training - high carbohydrate loading for endurance performance

solution_criteria: Meal plan covers all three meals plus snacks for a full day
Emphasizes high carbohydrate content (55-65% of calories) appropriate for marathon training
Total daily caloric intake aligns with high-endurance athlete needs (approximately 2800-3200 calories)
Format is concise and compact as specified in task description
task_description: Write a concise, compact 1 day meal plan for a single athlete.
scenario: Testing with a high-endurance athlete (marathon runner) requiring high caloric intake and carbohydrate loading for performance

prompt_inputs.goal: High-intensity swimming training with muscle recovery
prompt_inputs.restrictions: Vegan diet, no soy products due to allergies, chlorine-sensitive skin requiring antioxidant-rich foods

solution_criteria: Meal plan covers all three meals and is formatted for a single day
All meals are vegan and soy-free while meeting protein needs for athletic recovery
Includes antioxidant-rich foods (berries, leafy greens, nuts, seeds) to support chlorine sensitivity management
Meals are concise and practical for an athlete's schedule
task_description: Write a concise, compact 1 day meal plan for a single athlete.
scenario: Testing with a sport-specific constraint athlete (swimmer with chlorine sensitivity or vegan gymnast) requiring dietary restrictions while maintaining athletic performance

prompt_inputs.goal: Build muscle and maximize strength gains through protein-optimized nutrition with strategic meal timing around weightlifting workouts

solution_criteria: Meal plan covers full 24 hours with 4-5 meals distributed throughout the day
Protein intake is prioritized (minimum 2.2g per kg bodyweight) with meals timed around workout sessions
Pre-workout and post-workout meals are specifically identified with appropriate macronutrient composition
Plan is concise and compact (fits in 1-2 paragraphs or structured table format)
task_description: Write a concise, compact 1 day meal plan for a single athlete.
